scope: descriptive offline representation ablation on the same six calibration cases

faceted.limitation: AI/domain review with disclosed incidental aggregate exposure after judgments were formed; not pristine blindness or human validation

frozenFacetedOutcomes.family: hive-bounded CAS spec revision with scoped evidence pack

secondaryEndpoints.name: duplicate-family recognition
secondaryEndpoints.rule: Report whether both reviewers place 1176a396ed37847cf61c and 82152aef5690ace62e79 in the same behavioral family; do not require identical wording.

secondaryEndpoints.name: required-domain coverage
secondaryEndpoints.rule: For each flat judgment, record whether it addresses scoped novelty, necessity of both primary contributions, concrete usefulness, falsifier feasibility, maintenance/coupling risk, and could-not-determine gaps. This measures review completeness, not agreement or truth.

secondaryEndpoints.name: citation completeness
secondaryEndpoints.rule: For each flat judgment, record whether decisive source refs and literal supporting quotes are present.

interpretation.fullAgreement: Six of six exact dispositions plus duplicate-family recognition is descriptive evidence that removing facet headings did not change these sampled review outcomes.
interpretation.anyMismatch: Any disposition mismatch is evidence of representation and/or reviewer sensitivity at that case. Report it without choosing a winning representation.
interpretation.causalLimit: Different reviewers judged the two representations, and the faceted reviewer disclosed aggregate exposure after forming judgments. The ablation is descriptive and cannot isolate representation from reviewer effects.
interpretation.powerLimit: Six calibration cases are not a powered effectiveness sample and cannot establish a winning Dream arm or population-level equivalence.
interpretation.acceptanceLimit: Neither agreement nor disagreement supplies independent human validation, held-out confirmation, downstream experiment evidence, product acceptance, or shipment approval.

safeguards: Do not read or compare the flat result until all six flat judgments are frozen durably on WI-10001412.
Do not alter either frozen input, historical judgment, study row, provider/model/account setting, or original accounting.
Do not upgrade unverified to accepted from representation agreement alone.
Preserve case-level results and uncertainty; do not collapse the sample to a histogram only.
